Lighting Controls in Storage Garages — partial. Applied: (1) zone area is CHECKED against the 360 m2 limit and an oversized zone is a shouted finding (re-zoning to satisfy a lighting rule would silently change the thermal results, so it is not done for you); (2) a >=30% unoccupied reduction is applied by schedule modulation — the 4.2.2.1.(16)-(23) convention, and note the general occupancy path CANNOT serve this since it is gated on LPD > 8.6 W/m2 while both garage records sit at 1.5-1.9 W/m2, and the Table 4.3.2.10 factors would give only 26.8%; (4) luminaire power within 6.1 m of a >=40% net-opening perimeter wall is derived as LPD x band area (the 4.2.2.1 convention) and a zone daylighting control is added above 150 W. Table 4.2.1.6. defers 'Storage garage interior' here rather than to 4.2.2.1.(10)/(13), so garages are correctly excluded from the ordinary photocontrol rule.
